title: Corpus dedup
description: The output of Corpus.Dedup over a corpus-report/4 (or /3, /2, /1) document: the near-duplicate merge across the completed shards of a run. Per shard a keep mask over the product's documents; the clusters of two or more as (shard, ordinal) pairs, listed up to a cap — the masks carry the complete decision. A signatures blob is used only when it is what the report says of it: its length that of one signature per document of the product, its bytes hashing to the report's signatures_sha256, its header the run's MinHash parameters; a shard whose blob is not is left out and named in excluded, with no mask. A run without signatures (output stats_and_hashes, or sign false), a report that names one shard or one blob twice, and a run with more documents than one merge holds are refused, by name, before any blob is read. Version 2: version 1 merged whatever a blob held.

threshold.description: The Jaccard estimate a pair needed to be one cluster.

bands.description: LSH bands over the signature (16 by default; pipeline.minhash.bands).

hashes.description: Hashes per signature of the signatures merged (128 by default). Absent from documents of controllers before 0.3.0.

shingle_words.description: Words per shingle of the signatures merged (5 by default). Absent from documents of controllers before 0.3.0.

excluded.description: Completed shards left out: their signatures blob is not what the report says of it.

duplicates.description: Documents that are near-duplicates of an earlier one (the mask drops them).

clusters_listed.description: How many of them the document lists.

keep.description: A bitset over the shard's product: bit i of byte i/8, least significant first, 1 = keep document i (the i-th JSON line of the text blob).

excluded.description: The completed shards the merge left out, in index order. Such a shard has no mask and its documents are in no cluster: keep it whole, drop it, or run it again.

reason.description: blob_missing: the blob is not in the store. blob_length: not one signature per document of the product. blob_header: not a signatures blob of the run's parameters. blob_hash: its bytes do not hash to the report's signatures_sha256 (not the signatures integrity compared). parameters: the report states other MinHash parameters for this shard than for the run.

clusters.description: Each cluster: its documents as [shard index, ordinal] pairs in ascending order, the representative (the kept one) first.
